ATLANTA, USA

Currently, I am sharpening my creative strategy at SCAD while leading tours at SCAD FASH and co-founding the Fashion Society, all alongside embracing Atlanta’s vibrant culture, warmth, and daily rhythms.

TEL AVIV, ISRAEL

In Israel, I earned my first Masters, began my career at Payoneer, and completed my first marathon, marking a transformative chapter of independence, resilience, and discovery in a country defined by its dynamism and depth.

NEW DELHI, INDIA

India is where my roots lie, born in Gujarat, raised in Delhi, with family from Rajasthan. It is where I inherited heritage, philosophy, and textiles, and where the foundation of my curiosity for culture and commerce first took shape.

DOHA, QATAR

In Doha, three years of school gave me an early introduction to Gulf luxury and hospitality, while my teenage years unfolded against a backdrop of modern skylines, cultural richness, and traditions that left a lasting impression on how I see the world.

SRI LANKA

In Sri Lanka, an international school environment filled with cultural diversity taught me the value of community, openness, and adaptability. Beyond the classroom, swimming and an active outdoor life added balance and freedom, shaping a chapter of growth that was as enriching personally as it was academically.
